subject: Post-demo compliance gapcheck & request for SOC 2 Type II artifacts
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Shaw <jordan.shaw@peridot.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo compliance gapcheck & request for SOC 2 Type II artifacts

Hi Jordan — thanks again for a great demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the pilot:

- Summary: Peridot is a strong fit for the conversational inference workflow we discussed; primary ask from your side was predictable latency and auditability.
- Compliance signals we need to validate for procurement: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period), a signed bridge letter if the Type II covering the most recent period is not yet public, and temporary access to your trust portal so our security team can pull artifacts (policies, evidence snapshots, DSAR handling notes).

To help the security team triage, can you confirm:
1) Whether Peridot has a SOC 2 Type II for the period Mar 2026–Feb 2027 (or later) and whether the report covers the inference service and relevant subservice providers.
2) If the Type II is not yet released, can you share a bridge letter that covers controls through the pilot start date?
3) Can you provision read-only access for compliance@redwood.inference.com to your trust portal or send us a short-lived export?

I've attached a brief evidence checklist that maps the items we'll look for (policies, last penetration test, vendor DDQ answers). If you can point us to the portal or attach the SOC 2 artifact, we'll triage scope and come back with any follow-ups.

Target timeline: if we can get portal access or the report/bridge letter this week, security should be able to complete a preliminary review within 3 business days.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf
From: Jordan Shaw <jordan.shaw@peridot.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Peridot Security <security@peridot.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance gapcheck & request for SOC 2 Type II artifacts

Grace — thanks for the clear recap and checklist. Happy to help. Short answers up front:

- We do have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period Apr 2026–Mar 2027 that covers our inference platform; I attached a summary extract for your review.
- We can provide a signed bridge letter that covers the gap until the full report distribution is public.
- We'll provision read-only access to our trust portal for compliance@redwood.inference.com but we need a signed DPA or confirmation of the data processing perimeter before we enable access.

Two quick asks from our side: can you confirm the exact email(s) to grant portal access to, and can your legal/compliance team sign our standard DPA? I can loop our contracts lead if you need a redline window.

I'm cc'ing our security lead (security@peridot.ai) so they can coordinate portal provisioning and attach the bridge letter once signed. Attached: peridot-soc2-summary.pdf (high level).

— Jordan
Jordan Shaw
Director of Product, Peridot AI
jordan.shaw@peridot.ai

Attachments: peridot-soc2-summary.pdf

Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance gapcheck & request for SOC 2 Type II artifacts

Jordan — perfect, thanks. Please provision read-only access for: compliance@redwood.inference.com and engineering-security@redwood.inference.com. If you need an IP allowlist we can provide our egress ranges.

On the DPA: attaching a countersigned copy of Peridot’s standard DPA would be ideal. If you prefer, we can sign your version — if you can send a link or DocuSign I’ll prioritize.

Ben/Aditya — looped you both to keep legal/compliance aware. Ben, heads up on timeline (Jordan said portal + bridge letter possible this week with DPA agreement).

Thanks — Grace

Attachments: signed-dpa-request-form.pdf

Jordan — quick clarifying items from procurement/security so we can finalize the pilot contract: 

1) Please confirm the SOC 2 Type II reporting period (cover start/end dates) and whether the report includes any subcontracted cloud infra or third-party model providers.
2) For the bridge letter, can you explicitly state the control period it covers and the date it was signed?
3) Will the portal export include the pen test report and change management artifacts (high-level redacted logs OK)?

If we have the bridge letter and portal access this week, Procurement can proceed with a pilot PO and we can get engineering access on a short timeline.

— Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Shaw <jordan.shaw@peridot.ai>

Thanks all — updates below and attaching the artifacts you requested.

- SOC 2 Type II report period: 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 (covers our inference layer and the AWS accounts listed in Appendix B). See attached peridot-soc2-typeii-2027.pdf.
- Bridge letter: attached, signed today 2027-11-29; explicitly covers controls through 2027-11-29 while the public report distribution is finalized. See peridot-bridge-letter-signed.pdf.
- Portal provisioning: created a read-only invite for compliance@redwood.inference.com and engineering-security@redwood.inference.com. Portal link: https://trust.peridot.ai/portal/invite/GTZ-9QH2. Temporary credentials are being sent in a separate secure message by our security team. The export includes pen test executive summary, evidence snapshots, and DDQ answers (PII redacted as appropriate).

We'll follow up by email with the secure credential message and any additional exports. Let us know if you need a narrow IP allowlist.

— Jordan
